messages:
Alex King: FYI multiple customers reporting 502s and truncated streams after SDK 1.7 rollout about 30m ago. Repro locally with paging + streaming enabled.
Priya Rao: seeing it too. stack shows 'incompatible frame header' when client hits multi-page streaming endpoints. :rotating_light: paging+streaming combo seems new in 1.7
Mateo Cruz: tagging oncall — Priya do you have a minimal repro?
Priya Rao: paste below, quick repro:
```
client = RedwoodSDK(v=1.7)
resp = client.stream_pages('/v1/search', params={"q":"foo","page_size":50})
# hangs then 502
```
logs: `ERR frame_parsing: invalid header 0x0a` from proxy-streamer on prod-gw-2
Jin Park: incident-bot: Affected routes: /v1/search (paging), /v1/stream-chat (paging fallback). Initial error rate +420% since 1924000000.
incident-bot: Paging/Streaming Incompatibility detected by healthcheck (rule: sdk-version-compat).
Alex King: immediate mitigation options: 1) flip kill-flag for sdk-paging_stream_mix 2) rollback SDK service to 1.6 (server-side compatibility shim) 3) temporary rate-limit canary customers.
Mateo Cruz: I can flip kill-flag. Who owns the flag?
Priya Rao: flag is `ff.sdk.paging_mux` in LaunchDarkly env=prod. Jin can flip if you have access.
Jin Park: I have LD access. Flipping now -> `ff.sdk.paging_mux` OFF.
deploy-bot: deploy activity: LD flag `ff.sdk.paging_mux` toggled OFF by Jin Park at 1924000300.
Priya Rao: checking metrics... error rate dropping on gw-2, 502s down from 420% -> 90% from baseline in 2m. Looks promising.
Customer Support: multiple customers reported via support channel: AcmeCorp, BrightLoan. AcmeCorp reported truncated conversation for 3 users. Notified them of mitigation flip.
Alex King: start rollback plan in parallel — if flag flip insufficient we should roll server or push a patch to the streaming mux. Mateo, can you prep rollback steps?
Mateo Cruz: prepping. Plan: 1) cut traffic off new canary routing on prod-gw-2 2) deploy compat-shim to runtime (binary v1.6-compat) 3) run smoke tests on /v1/search and streaming endpoints 4) promote. ETA 25m if no blockers.
Priya Rao: uploading quick config diff for shim:
```
# runtime shim env
STREAM_FRAME_MODE=legacy
MAX_PAGE_FRAME_SIZE=65536
```
Jin Park: I can route canary back to stable nodes now, starting traffic drain on gw-2.
deploy-bot: canary routing adjustment initiated by Jin Park at 1924000450.
incident-bot: On-call handoff reminder: Priya Rao -> Mateo Cruz in 35m.
Alex King: customer impact note: partial outages on paging+streaming for ~28m affecting ~0.2% of active accounts but hitting high-traffic customers. Recommend status page update: "degradation for streaming search with paging; engineers investigating; mitigation in progress".
Customer Support: Draft message ready.
Customer Support: "We are experiencing degraded streaming search for a subset of customers. Engineers have applied a mitigation and are monitoring. We will provide updates every 30 minutes."
Mateo Cruz: rolling shim to runtime pool now. Command: `kubectl set image deploy/runtime runtime=image:redwood/runtime:1.6-compat --namespace=prod`
Alex King: monitor token-level logs for frame errors, grep: `frame_parsing` across gw pods.
Priya Rao: smoke after shim: streaming + paging passes on staging perf. Applying to 10% prod nodes first.
deploy-bot: rollout started: runtime:1.6-compat -> 10% at 1924001200.
Jin Park: error rate trending down to +15% vs baseline. Latency stable.
Mateo Cruz: promoting to 50% now.
Priya Rao: can we get a quick E2E from AcmeCorp contact? they said they can test but need guidance.
Customer Support: pinged AcmeCorp account team, they will test in ~10m.
Alex King: timeline: mitigation flip at +2m, shim partial rollout started +35m, 50% by +55m. If 50% looks good we'll promote to 100% and close.
incident-bot: Please record postmortem if rollout caused client incompat; severity candidate: Sev2.
Mateo Cruz: 100% rollout complete at 1924003600. 
Priya Rao: all checks green, no new frame parsing errors in last 10m, customer tests successful.
Alex King: followups: - triage root cause of protocol change in SDK 1.7 (client-side framing) - add integration test for paging+streaming combos - add pre-rollout gate for sdk-server compatibility matrix - update release notes with breaking change section
Jin Park: creating a follow-up ticket: INF-4521 "SDK 1.7 paging/streaming framing incompat" and assigning to eng-ml + eng-runtime.
Customer Support: AcmeCorp confirmed recovered. BrightLoan still verifying but no new errors.
Alex King: closing the live incident channel. We will run a postmortem tomorrow 10:00 PT. Thanks all. :tada:
